notes: BUU 2.0 v2.2.4 - hotfix: step-by-step window restored. Pool worker now launches headed (visible browser) when startMode is step or step-row, headless when run-all. The v2.2.2 Tier 2 unification (single-runner deleted, pool worker became the sole runtime) had inherited the pool worker's headless:true default, so step-by-step from v2.2.2 onward opened no window — the user could click "Next step" but had nothing to watch. This release restores legacy behavior. No other changes from v2.2.3. All v2.2.3 features (verify-after-action, diagnostic capture, dialog logging, log retention, archive button) unchanged. Built on v2.2.3, v2.2.2, v2.2.1, v2.2.0.
